items.title: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
items.description: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after backlash over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit more sites of Russian online retailer Wildberries
items.description: Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions were struck overnight.

items.title: Iran war has cost US $37.5bn so far, Hegseth says, as Pentagon seeks billions more
items.description: The hearing was disrupted by protests and a shouting match as Hegseth testified at a pivotal time in the war.

items.title: India's Modi government under growing pressure as 'cockroach' protests intensify
items.description: The CJP got a boost on Tuesday when the opposition Congress party demonstrated outside the PM's house.

items.title: France passes law banning under-15s from social media
items.description: The law will require social media platforms in France to verify all users age from January.

items.title: Tokyo urges men to wear shorts to work, but some women say it's 'leg hair harassment'
items.description: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government wants workers to ditch the suit and tie for t-shirts, trainers - and shorts.

items.title: Police station opens at Hitler's birthplace in bid to rid site of Nazi link
items.description: The opening follows years of controversy about what to do with the 17th-Century former inn, where the Nazi dictator was born.

items.title: US renews strikes on Iran as Trump threatens to attack underground nuclear site
items.description: The US president's threat to target a key Iranian nuclear site came ahead of the 11th consecutive night of attacks.

items.title: Michelin-starred restaurateur faces jail for using ants as dessert garnish
items.description: Officials say the restaurant in South Korea used some 49,000 ants in various dishes over four years.

items.title: Rebel Wilson cleared in defamation case brought by actress in her own film
items.description: Wilson was accused of defaming young Australian actress Charlotte MacInnes, but cleared by a Sydney court.

items.title: Gruesome images in D4vd hearing are 'worst nightmare' for teen girl's family
items.description: The court hears the singer ordered a body bag, chainsaws and an inflatable pool to dispose of the teen's body.

items.title: Tunnel collapse in India kills 12 workers
items.description: Rescue operation is ongoing but hazardous conditions have hampered efforts to reach those still inside.
